$comment: U49 -- close out H2, the TC2030-IDC-NL Tag-Connect debug header.
Four independent defects, applied in one atomic pass so the zones refill once.
Every clearance below is exact point-segment math against tools/kicad_rules.json:
track centreline to a pad EDGE                  = 0.1016 + 0.127 = 0.2286
track centreline to another track centreline    = 0.3556
via (0.6) centre to a track centreline          = 0.5286
track centreline to an NPTH hole CENTRE         = 0.4953 + 0.2 + 0.127 = 0.8223
The 0.2 there is min_hole_clearance, which is the rule the pours were failing.

steps.step: 1/4  hole_clearance x12 -- ban the pour over H2's three alignment holes
$why: H2's NPTH alignment holes are drill 0.9906 (r 0.4953). The four pours (GND on
Top/Bottom/Inner1, +5V on Inner2) fill to min_clearance 0.1016 and so land at
0.1021 from every hole -- under the 0.2 mm min_hole_clearance rule. 3 holes x 4
zones = the 12 errors. Nothing upstream is wrong; the two rules simply disagree,
and the pour is the side that has to yield.
Octagon circumradius 0.85 -> inradius 0.85*cos(22.5) = 0.7853, so the pour stops
0.7853 - 0.4953 = 0.290 mm from the hole edge. 1.45x the rule.
vias stay LEGAL: SWO's own escape via lands at (135.212,120.200), inside H2's
courtyard. Banning vias here would have blocked step 4 from the other side.
Sized to touch no existing via either -- nearest copper approach is the +3V3 via
at (130.442,120.668), 1.030 mm from hole A's centre against the 0.85 radius.

steps.step: 2/4  shorting_items -- jog Bottom /NRST east around the /BTN2 via
$why: The /NRST bottom run is a 10.05 mm straight at x=133.500. The /BTN2 via sits at
(133.400,115.200) -- 0.100 mm off that line against the 0.5286 a 0.6 via needs.
A VIA IS A DISC ON EVERY LAYER, so checking this segment against Bottom copper
alone finds nothing. The full-layer sweep also turns up a second one, /BTN1 at
(136.000,113.600); the jog is sized to clear both.
Jog east, not west: east of x=133.5 the Bottom layer is empty here, west of it
sits the /SWDIO via at (132.672,119.800).
Closest approaches after the jog: /BTN2 via 0.700 (needs 0.5286), /BTN1 via 1.923.

steps.step: 3/4  hole_clearance -- walk Bottom /+3V3 around H2's west alignment hole
$why: The H2 pad-1 escape dives at (132.672,123.400) and runs diagonally to the +3V3
via at (130.442,120.668). That diagonal passes 0.162 mm from the alignment hole
at (131.402,121.588) -- straight THROUGH it, hence the reported 0.0000 actual.
The via is only 1.330 mm from the hole, so the tangents from it to the 0.8223
keep-out circle are 38.2 deg either side of the line to the hole: every approach
between 5.6 and 82.0 deg clips it. That kills the gentle diagonals and is why
this is an L, not a bend.
Approach due south (90 deg) instead: the vertical at x=130.442 clears the hole
centre by 0.960 mm. Chamfered at 45 deg to match the rest of the board.
Segment clearances to the hole centre: 1.812 / 1.579 / 0.960, all over 0.8223.
U1.130 is a 0.28 x 2.0 mm LQFP lead with 0.220 mm neighbours either side, so it
has exactly two exits: its north tip and its south tip. Both were closed.
SOUTH is a dead end, not merely tight. The gate between C6.2's corner
the 0.4572 two-sided clearance a 0.254 track needs -- and even necking through
it only reaches a pocket sealed by C6.2's east edge and the /CAN2_RX diagonal,
0.390 mm apart against the 0.5842 that same track needs. Nothing exits.
NORTH had 0.644 mm before the /+3V3 diagonal, which is enough for a track and
not for a via: a 0.6 via needs its centre 0.7475 mm clear of a 45 deg neighbour,
which lands it at y=119.903 -- inside the pad. A 0.5/0.2 via (the U1.93
precedent) still lands at 119.833, also inside. There is no via that fits.
So the /+3V3 east branch moves. It is the only thing in the wedge, and north of
it the LQFP interior is empty for 12 mm. Rebranching it 1.7 mm west off the
y=119.466 run costs +0.5 mm of rail in free space and opens a 1.35 mm corridor;
the existing y=118.450 horizontal is untouched, only extended west to meet it.
SWO then exits north into that corridor, vias down at (151.750,119.200) with
0.750 to the moved rail, and crosses to H2 on Bottom -- which is empty for the
whole 15.5 mm span but for one /GND via at (140.578,116.858), 2.64 mm clear.
The H2 end approaches pad 6 from the NORTH. It has to: the alignment hole at
(136.482,120.572) is 0.381 mm off the pad-6 row against the 0.8223 a track
needs, so no pad on this connector can be reached horizontally. The Bottom run
sits at y=119.500, 1.072 mm north of that hole.
